title: 第17章 攻守异形第18章 出口恶气
lines: “打啊，你怎么不打了？”
吴谦学着范岱的口气，略做修改，还了回去。
“今天打不死我，你就不是男人！”
凭借着对自卫术保命的信心，吴谦此言一出，打赢了是赢，输了也是赢，瞬间立于不败之地。
范岱闻言双目通红，重新被激起凶性，刚生出的迟疑烟消云散。
只见范岱手掐印诀，身体周围的空气迅速灼热。
下一刻，一条火龙自身前飞出，跟随范岱指尖所向，疾速飞往不远处的吴谦。
众人皆脸色大变，看热闹的也不敢再看，连声齐呼，
“范公公息怒，不能在皇宫杀人！”
两个年纪大的太监，有心出手阻拦火龙，却被范岱用眼神逼退。
“今天谁敢多管闲事，与吴谦同罪处治！”
众人知道范岱已经杀红眼，不敢再劝，只能趁范岱无暇分心，赶紧跑去给总管报信。
死一个吴谦没什么，但死在后宫重地，可不是闹着玩。
到时候每个人都有责任，就算总管不追究，皇家也要追查此事。
范岱连番施法，最后一招更是越阶施展的大杀招，炼气境的灵力已近透支，不断喘着粗气。
另一边，吴谦通过自卫术脑补的知识，认出这是火龙术，一般炼气境圆满后才能施展。
想要发挥出此术的最佳杀力，则需要筑基境修为。
眼前这条火龙只有杯口粗细，显然并非完整形态。
但对于炼气境五阶的范岱来说，已是极限之举。
吴谦知道，此时范岱不惜耗尽灵力，也要强行使用此术，是想一击毙命，不愿再来回拉扯。
“这厮真敢杀人啊！”
吴谦首当其冲，面对凶神恶煞的火龙，来不及后悔，自卫术飞速运转。
不多的灵力自丹田喷涌而出，在面前汇聚成一片光雾，这次光雾更厚更亮，如有实物，像一面圆镜。
身体则不由自主再次前扑，迎头撞向火龙。
吴谦也颇感无奈，自卫术好像就这德行，哪法力强就往哪撞，属于是法术自带的护驾属性。
这次对撞，吴谦出奇的没倒飞出去，而是一头栽到地上。
又被余威拖出好远，在地面划出一道沟壑后，才缓缓停下。
范岱把气喘匀，拖着疲惫不堪的肥躯，来到吴谦身边立定。
俯视着一动不动的吴谦，居高临下道，
“不自量力！”
似乎是听到了范岱的话，吴谦食指微动。
关键时刻，吴谦及时调出系统面板，在灵力即将完全耗尽前一瞬，把修为提升到炼精期九阶。
这是多次劳动换来的经验，每次体力耗尽时，升阶便能如获新生，如今用在争斗中，效果立竿见影。
在所有人都以为胜负已分时，吴谦不顾周围人震惊的目光，艰难爬起身来，重新站好。
体内灵力重新充盈，吴谦吐出嘴里草泥，然后又吐出两个字，
“就这？”
范岱被惊的说不出话来，连退数步，愕然看向死而复生的吴谦。
吴谦就算只是炼精期小白，也知道跨境施法的后果，轻则灵力耗尽，重则遭到反噬。
看范岱上气不接下气的样子，应该是精疲力尽，嘲笑道，
“没劲了？”
说着迈出坚定步伐，亦步亦趋走过去。
范岱目露惊恐，被迫连连后退，不知到底发生了什么。
明明是自己速战速决的雷霆杀招，怎么就成了陷入被动的负担。
content_en:
"Fight, why don't you fight?"
Wu Qian imitated Fan Dai's tone, made slight modifications, and returned it.
"If you can't kill me today, you are not a man!"
Relying on his confidence in self-defense skills to save his life, Wu Qian said this, winning is a win, losing is a win, and he is instantly invincible.
Fan Dai's eyes turned red when he heard this, and his ferocity was aroused again, and his new hesitation disappeared.
Fan Dai was seen making seals with his hands, and the air around his body was rapidly burning.
The next moment, a fire dragon flew out in front of itself, followed the direction of Fan Dai's fingertips, and flew quickly to Wu Qian not far away.
Everyone's expressions changed greatly, and those who were watching the excitement did not dare to look anymore, and they shouted in unison,
"Eunuch Fan, calm down, you can't kill people in the palace!"
The two older eunuchs wanted to stop the fire dragon, but Fan Dai forced them back with his eyes.
"Whoever dares to meddle in other people's business today will be punished with the same crime as Wu Qian!"
Everyone knew that Fan Dai was already jealous and did not dare to persuade him any more. They could only take advantage of Fan Dai's lack of time and distraction and hurried to report the news to the general manager.
It's okay to die as a Wu Qian, but to die in the center of the harem is no joke.
At that time, everyone will be responsible. Even if the general manager does not pursue the matter, the royal family will investigate the matter.
Fan Dai cast spells repeatedly, and the last move was a killing move that he performed across the level. His spiritual power in the Qi Refining Realm was nearly exhausted, and he kept breathing heavily.
On the other side, Wu Qian recognized that this was the Fire Dragon Technique through the knowledge he gained from the self-defense technique, which could only be used after the Qi Refining Realm was completed.
If you want to bring out the best killing power of this technique, you need to practice at the Foundation Establishment level.
The fire dragon in front of me was only as thick as the mouth of a cup, so it was obviously not in its complete form.
But for Fan Dai, who is at the fifth level of the Qi Refining Realm, this is already the ultimate move.
Wu Qian knew that Fan Dai did not hesitate to use this technique forcefully at this time, because he wanted to kill him with one blow and did not want to pull back and forth.
"This guy really dares to kill someone!"
Wu Qian was the first to bear the brunt. Facing the ferocious fire dragon, he had no time to regret, and his self-defense skills were in full swing.
A small amount of spiritual power gushes out from the Dantian and gathers into a mist of light in front of him. This time the mist is thicker and brighter, as if it were a real thing, like a round mirror.
The body involuntarily rushed forward again, hitting the fire dragon head-on.
Wu Qian also felt quite helpless. The virtue of self-defense seemed to be this. He would hit wherever the magic was strong. It was the protective attribute of the magic.
In this collision, Wu Qian surprisingly did not fly backwards, but fell to the ground.
He was dragged a long distance by Yu Wei, and then slowly stopped after drawing a ravine on the ground.
Fan Dai took a deep breath, dragged his exhausted fat body, and came to stand next to Wu Qian.
Looking down at the motionless Wu Qian, he said condescendingly,
"Don't overestimate your capabilities!"
Wu Qian's index finger moved slightly as if he heard Fan Dai's words.
At the critical moment, Wu Qian called up the system panel in time and raised his cultivation level to the ninth level of the refining stage just before his spiritual power was completely exhausted.
This is the experience gained from many times of hard work. Every time when the physical strength is exhausted, the upgrade can be like a new life. Now used in battles, the effect is immediate.
When everyone thought the winner was decided, Wu Qian ignored the shocked looks of the people around him, climbed up with difficulty, and stood up again.
With the spiritual power in his body replenished, Wu Qian spit out grass mud from his mouth, and then spit out two words,
"That's it?"
Fan Dai was so shocked that he couldn't speak. He took a few steps back and looked at Wu Qian who had come back from the dead in shock.
Even if Wu Qian is just a novice in the refining stage, he still knows the consequences of cross-border spellcasting, ranging from exhaustion of spiritual power to severe backlash.
Seeing that Fan Dai was out of breath, he must be exhausted, so he laughed and said,
"No energy?"
As he spoke, he took firm steps and walked over step by step.
Fan Dai looked horrified and was forced to retreat repeatedly, not knowing what was going on.
It was obviously his quick and decisive thunderous move, but why did it become a passive burden?
